critical_steps: The unperturbed one-block system has energy exactly \(\|K^*f\|^2\).
The perturbation operator has exact norm \(\delta\) and satisfies Theorem 3.18 with \(a=b=0\), \(c=\delta<1\).
The vector \(-\delta e_1+e_2\) lies in the perturbed analysis kernel but has nonzero \(K^*\)-image.
On \(R(K)\), the identity \(g=(K^\dagger)^*K^*g\) gives the norm conversion used by the theorem.
If every \(W_j\subseteq R(K)\), all analysis energies depend only on \(P_{R(K)}f\), so the source estimate becomes valid.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact one-parameter counterfamily on \(\mathbb C^2\), plus a range-restricted Moore--Penrose repair.
integrity.unproved_limits: No necessary-and-sufficient characterization of all ambient-norm perturbations preserving a K-g-fusion frame is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The finding refutes Theorem 3.18 as printed and proves a sufficient range-based repair.
The condition \(W_j\subseteq R(K)\) is sufficient rather than asserted necessary.
A highly relevant 2016 stability paper was available only at bibliographic/abstract level in the checked public sources, so it remains a residual literature risk.
title: Ambient-norm perturbations do not stabilize noninjective \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion frames
